payload.title: File:Batrachomimus pastosbonensis.jpg
payload.description_html:
Life restoration of Batrachomimus pastosbonensis.
  • Head based on figures in "A new neosuchian with Asian affinities from the Jurassic of northeastern Brazil" by Felipe C. Montefeltro, Hans C. E. Larsson, Marco A. G. de França, and Max C. Langer (Naturwissenschaften in press)
  • Osteoderms based on those of Shamosuchus djadochtaensis, described in "Morphology of the Late Cretaceous crocodylomorph Shamosuchus djadochtaensis and a discussion of neosuchian phylogeny as related to the origin of Eusuchia" by Diego Pol, Alan H. Turner, and Mark A. Norell (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 324: 1-103).
